item.title: Join the Jazz and Justice Circle
item.description: To all past, present, and future major donors to WPFW: WPFW is pleased to announce the revamping, renaming, and relaunch of the WPFW major donor recognition program to now be known as the Jazz & Justice Circle. - formally known as the Circle of Excellence. Learn more on how you can become a member by CLICKING HERE.

item.title: An Interview with Cuban Ambassador Lianys Torres Rivera
item.description: An Interview with Ambassador Lianys Torres Rivera by Katea Stitt (The interview will be re-broadcast on Tuesday, March 17, at 7PM on WPFW) KS: Greetings, Ambassador Lianys Torres Rivera, Cuban Ambassador to the United States. It's such an honor to have you. And I also want to say happy International Women's Day to you yesterday, of course, but today we also say happy International Women's Day to you.
